mm: A mm is a metric unit of length equal to one thousandth of a meter.
Mm means the same as millimeter or millimetre.
mm hg: A mm Hg is a unit of pressure equal to 0.001316 atmosphere.
Mm Hg means the same as torr or millimeter of mercury.
mmpi: MMPI is a self-report personality inventory consisting of 550 items that describe feelings or actions which the person is asked to agree with or disagree with.
MMPI means the same as Minnesota Multiphasic Personality Inventory.
